name: Huviena Inventory Analytics for WooCommerce
author: loke26

sections.description:
When inventory grows across a busy catalog, it becomes hard to answer the questions that matter:

  • Which products may stock out soon?
  • What should we buy first?
  • Which items are tying up cash in overstock or dead stock?
  • Where is demand rising or falling?
  • Which products need a quick review before the next buying decision?

Huviena Inventory Analytics for WooCommerce turns raw WooCommerce data into a simple inventory intelligence dashboard. It adds inventory health scoring, stock forecast signals, reorder recommendations, overstock detection, slow-moving alerts, inventory aging, and lost-sales context without requiring an external service.

Source and build notes

The plugin’s admin JavaScript is maintained as human-readable source in assets/js/admin.js. It is handwritten and is not generated, minified, or bundled from another source file. The admin stylesheet is maintained directly in assets/css/admin.css; no generated asset build step is required.

Source repository: https://github.com/lokeshdeshmukh/WordPressAIAnalytics

What it does

  • Shows a WooCommerce inventory dashboard with product-level attention states.
  • Highlights Stocking Out Soon items so you can act before revenue slips.
  • Surfaces What to Buy recommendations with product images, prices, SKUs, categories, stock status, and pagination.
  • Creates a draft coupon for slow-moving or overstocked products so you can move stock faster.
  • Flags overstock, slow-moving, and dead stock products so you can clear excess inventory earlier.
  • Tracks rising demand and falling demand to support smarter demand forecasting.
  • Opens a product detail page with charts, current metrics, and plain-English guidance.
  • Exports inventory data to CSV for offline review.
  • Refreshes on a configurable WordPress cron schedule, every 30 minutes by default.

Why store owners need it

WooCommerce stores usually know how much stock is available, but not which products are about to become a problem. This plugin helps answer the merchant questions that matter most:

  • What is at risk of stocking out?
  • What should we buy next?
  • What should we stop buying for now?
  • Where is money stuck in slow-moving inventory?
  • Which products are rising in demand and should be promoted?

Instead of ERP-style complexity, the plugin keeps the workflow focused on store-owner decisions: stock alerts, reorder guidance, overstock cleanup, and demand forecasting.

Key features

  • Inventory health score and attention breakdown
  • Stock-out risk and reorder recommendations
  • What to Buy tab for purchase priority
  • Inventory tab with product image, price, filters, and pagination
  • Demand tab with rising demand and falling demand views
  • Product detail drill-down with trend charts
  • Inventory value, aging, and lost-sales summaries
  • Optional email notifications and monthly inventory reports
  • Local-only data storage inside your WordPress database

Free vs Pro

The free MVP includes the core dashboard, product detail page, filters, pagination, CSV export, and settings for refresh timing and alerts.

Pro is positioned at ₹100/month. In this MVP, the Pro tab is a preview of the premium positioning for inventory rescue workflows, guided purchase lists, extra automation, and richer alerting. No external payment or cloud checkout flow is required for the free core plugin.

Support

This plugin is designed to stay local to your store. If you run into an issue, check the Settings tab, confirm WooCommerce is active, and allow the first background sync to finish before testing again.

Privacy

This plugin stores inventory snapshots, calculated metrics, and alert records in your WordPress database. It does not transmit order or product data to third-party services. Email alerts use your configured WordPress mail transport.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/huviena-inventory-analytics-for-woocommerce
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active
  4. Open WooCommerce -> Huviena Inventory Analytics for WooCommerce
  5. Wait for the first background refresh to populate historical data
sections.faq:
What is Huviena Inventory Analytics for WooCommerce?

It is a WooCommerce inventory intelligence dashboard that helps you spot stock-out risk, overstock, slow-moving products, dead stock, reorder opportunities, and demand shifts.

Can it predict stock-outs?

Yes. The plugin uses local WooCommerce sales and stock patterns to estimate stock-out risk and highlight products that may run low soon.

Does it work with HPOS?

This MVP is built around WooCommerce APIs and local store data. If your site uses HPOS, test on staging first so you can confirm it matches your store setup.

How often does it refresh?

By default, the plugin recalculates every 30 minutes through WordPress cron. You can change the refresh interval in the Settings tab.

How much does Pro cost?

Pro is positioned at ₹100/month. The MVP includes a Pro preview tab, but no payment or cloud checkout is connected.

Can I create coupons for slow-moving products?

Yes. Slow-moving or overstocked products now surface a Create coupon action that opens the inventory rescue modal and builds a campaign for review.

Does it send my store data to another service?

No. This plugin uses local WordPress and WooCommerce data only.

How do I open the portal?

In wp-admin, open the WooCommerce menu and click Huviena Inventory Analytics for WooCommerce.

Can I change notifications?

Yes. Use the Settings tab to control email notifications, alert types, and monthly reports.
